# Manga Again (再漫画) fixtures

`series.html` retains the public [斗佛](https://www.zaimanhua.com/info/doufo.html) metadata and 46 visible chapter links captured on 2026-10-25. The work uses slug `doufo` and comic ID `83175`.

`contract.json` preserves the consumed fields from both catalog API variants, with matching chapter identities and all seven issued page URLs for chapter `195373`. The variants expose author and genre metadata through different fields. Image paths and query keys are retained with controlled replacement signatures. Browser save tests use the complete catalog and page list with controlled PNG responses.
